answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The fable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the violet. What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
